title: Roy Craig interview with Lewis Chase, who denies knowledge
summary: Robert Salas tells of Roy Craig interview with Lewis Chase, who denies knowledge, about October 19, 1967 at MRI / Malmstrom Air Force Base, and reads it from an official document. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: >> The following interview conducted by Roy Craig is with Lieutenant Colonel Lewis D. Chase, who is chief of the operations division at Malmstrom Air Force Base, Montana.

plain: A former US Air Force officer, Robert Salas, played podcast host Jesse Michels a recorded interview from 1967 in which an investigator named Roy Craig questions Lieutenant Colonel Lewis Chase, head of operations at Malmstrom Air Force Base in Montana, a base that ran nuclear missiles. According to Salas, Chase says in the interview that he knows nothing about the incident being asked about, which Salas presents as part of a pattern of officials keeping quiet about UFO events at the base.
